blocks.raw: <Tip>**"Office = 4–6 ACH, Kitchen = 15 ACH, OR = 15–20 ACH (positive pressure)."** These are the three most-tested categories. Operating rooms are the most stringent (highest ACH, special pressure control, HEPA). Kitchens come next. Offices are baseline. Memorize this hierarchy.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={["Confusing air change rate (ACH, time-based) with air quality metrics (CO₂ ppm, particle counts)","Forgetting that operating rooms require positive pressure (to exclude contaminants, not enhance outflow)","Applying office ACH (4–6) to high-risk spaces like OR (15–20) or kitchens (15)","Calculating air volume without floor area or ceiling height (need all three: area × height × ACH)","Ignoring natural ventilation opening requirements (1:20 = 5% of floor area) if mechanical ventilation is specified; both may be required by code"]} />
